notes.title: Hurrah! New build R01 - "In the Zone" is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Just a bit more than a week after launch, here we are with a lot of new content! This update here is not just the average bunch of bug fixes for sure.

New maps, a new leaderboard, and streamlined user experience in the menus, hints for new players... for instance - only by launching the game - you'll see the completely overhauled menus:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SLfmKbd.jpg[/img]

And now for the big list of changes!

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]New "Riverside" Endless map with its own leaderboard (https://trello.com/c/pfq0fiEA/140-riverside)
[*]New "Archipelagus" 2v2 Deathmatch map (https://trello.com/c/Jvf6px4S/144-archipelagus)
[*]New "Mimelab" Solo Deathmatch map (https://trello.com/c/7NqRL2d3/143-mimelab)
[*]Added 5 Steam Trading Cards (https://trello.com/c/lHedRNR3/34-steam-trading-cards)
[*]Completely revised main menu (https://trello.com/c/cphSe2OE/126-title-and-quick-match-menus-overhaul)
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Some changes in the Great Escape stage layout
[*]New panel that tell who's winning in a Multiplayer match (https://trello.com/c/QlvvALoI/138-winning-ui-during-multiplayer-matches)
[*]If you stay in the Teleport for a long time, the game gives you a hint on how to come out (https://trello.com/c/MC8YMLgd/139-insert-a-notice-for-players-who-stay-in-the-teleport-for-too-long)
[*]Fixed an ugly bug that made bots not move in DeathMatch stages (found by IndigoReviews on YouTube)
[*]Fixed the fact that the time label covered the playable area in Moon stages (https://trello.com/c/olLsiUxY/80-time-label-overlaps-playable-space)
[*]Fixed compacted Chromos having no damage feedback (https://trello.com/c/koL0mJ1p/83-compacted-chromos-have-no-damage-feedback)
[*]Bots now don't head towards invisible players in Deathmatch (https://trello.com/c/iRd3w7J4/79-bots-head-towards-invisible-players-in-deathmatch)
[*]Players can now exit tutorial anytime (https://trello.com/c/AtLFALJF/12-players-can-t-exit-the-tutorial-once-it-starts)
[*]Time label now doesn't overlap playable space anymore (https://trello.com/c/olLsiUxY/80-time-label-overlaps-playable-space)
[*]Removed Time counter from Challenges that don't require it (https://trello.com/c/eqj93I3a/66-time-counter-in-challenges-that-don-t-require-it)
[*]All stage names are now translated!
[*]In Endless mode, if you're not in the top 6 the position shows "..." and not "1000" as before
[*]Changed the order of the stages a bit
[*]Updated stage layouts in the level selection
[*]Updated the Transport System explanation screen (finally!) (https://trello.com/c/1P3nM78i/145-update-the-transport-system-hint-with-the-latest-graphics)
[*]Added translators' names, and fixed the logo in the Credits  (https://trello.com/c/waDcurNY/96-credits-menu-featuring-translators)
[*]Moved around some Local Multi options (extra settings are now ALL in the Extra settings submenu), for a better menu experience
[/list]

Stay tuned for the next BIG update, coming in February.
Hint: it contains something you are all requesting A LOT... can you guess? ;-)

Until next time!

- Team ERROR

notes.title: Slybots: Frantic Zone is out today!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

we’re happy to announce the official launch of Slybots: Frantic Zone!

[img]http://www.slybots.com/ext_assets/visuals/its_on.jpg[/img]


So much has changed since last update, we have worked frantically to make the game cooler and cooler. What will you find in Slybots now? Here we go with a pretty list!

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]A long-awaited Deathmatch mode (trello.com/c/b5yEm7Eb/121-deathmatch)
[*]Pre-match tutorial for the Deathmatch mode (trello.com/c/NgmRwpdD/127-deathmatch-tutorial)
[*]More than 30 new in-game SFX (trello.com/c/MO513tBr/118-in-game-immersion-sfxs)
[*]2 new Challenges (trello.com/c/XJs7KLFo/130-invisibility-tutorial-challenge and trello.com/c/U9ji7bbA/117-public-transport-transport-system-tutorial)
[*]2 new maps for Solo Deathmatch (Vallis Alpes trello.com/c/eKeOJgLo/128-vallis-alpes and Power Failure trello.com/c/xsm4j4k0/137-power-failure)
[*]1 new map for 2v2 Deathmatch (Shackleton Crater trello.com/c/SS0ezR3L/132-shackleton-crater)
[*]2 new Challenge songs (Spin and Rust)
[*]2 new songs in Local Multiplayer (Le Saboteur and Instant Kwark)
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[*]All robots on the maps are now similar to the player's robots (Roboflak). It's easier to hide!
[*]Added even more controllers (trello.com/c/C69x50yC/112-add-compatibility-with-different-controllers)
[*]Now Challenges have to be unlocked, and register progress (trello.com/c/EgsedjAd/125-add-progression-to-the-challenges)
[*]Team ERROR and Mangatar logos at the beginning (trello.com/c/NESczy8V/120-intro-and-logos)
[*]Possibility to back out of the pre-match tutorial
[/list]

(as you can see many items are still linked to their items on [url=https://trello.com/b/YM4O95Z9/slybots-development]our Trello board[/url], which we will keep updated as we add new stuff!)


We’d like to thank all of you who have supported us so far.
Stay with us, because Slybots: Frantic Zone is going to surprise you even more!

- Team ERROR

notes.title: Happy new year! A minor update with a little gift
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Happy new year!
We have just pushed a minor Slybots update... in a sly way :)

If you open Steam today, the game will update itself and you'll see a new - albeit temporary - festive version of Slybots. Two things have changed:

[list]
    [*]First, you'll see on the battlefield a new "weapon": the Champagne Bottle. What better way to celebrate the new year than to spray your foes with a bottle of Moet et Chandon? Warning: it's harmless.
    [*]Two: you'll see Christmas presents popping out of the Transport System every now and then.
[/list]

[img]http://www.slybots.com/ext_assets/gifs/Champagne1.gif[/img]

But be warned: You have only 5 days to enjoy the new stuff. So, try Slybots before the 6th and celebrate with us!
(and did I mention it's still 30% off? hurry up, guys!)

Happy Sly Year, everybody!

notes.title: Quick development update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Just a quick update on the development and about the game in general (there's a lot of stuff to handle outside the development itself!! :D)

We are slowly rolling towards a [b]full release of the game[/b]. We don't have a final date yet, but we'll announce it soon, and the release day itself is going to be not very far in the future.

We also are a bit stretched after taking part in a couple of live events (we spoke about the GamesWeek Madrid [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/384100/announcements/detail/126456710478874983]here[/url]). These events have proven to be very interesting in terms of contacts, as we met people that are going to help us in making FATAL ERROR even better.

As such, we are not going to release a full update this weekend. We're probably just going to push one of those 'stealthy updates' with mostly bug fixes. We have some BIG changes to make, and you're going to see them very soon - don't worry.

[b]PS:[/b] if you haven't got the game yet, don't forget that it's going to be at 20% off for a couple of days as a part of the Halloween sale!

Until very soon!

notes.title: New build B07 - "King of Errors" is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! A new FATAL ERROR update is live!

This one is one of our biggest updates so far, with a brand new game mode (Endless Mode) complete with support for Steam Leaderboards, 5 Steam Achievements (and more to come), a new scenario for the aforementioned game mode (called "Great Escape"), a new robot (a minion called "Chromo"), improved feedback all around, possibility to change the language from inside the game, new glitchy menu graphics, and the usual plethora of bug fixes.

[h1]Endless Mode[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/R2SORwg.jpg[/img]

[i]"You are not getting out of here so easily!"[/i]

Endless mode is a new single-player game mode based on high score. You have to protect an exit from waves of endless black little robots, which will do anything to get through the exit portal. They'll use the Transport System and other stealthy tricks to confuse the player and get to the exit. How long can you keep them out?

The mode only has one scenario for now, but in future updates we'll add more stages and more ways to play, like [url=https://trello.com/c/TUNWBDpn/1-hack-the-wifi]Hack the WiFi[/url], and each one will have its own Leaderboard.

[h1]Changelist[/h1]

Here's a complete list of the changes:
[list]
[*]Endless game mode and a new stage Great Escape (https://trello.com/c/x9nDz3pO/54-endless-survival-mode)
[*]Steam Achievements (https://trello.com/c/zLttXeMO/22-design-the-achievements)
[*]Ability to change the language from the game menu (English, Italian, French, Spanish, German, Swedish, Neapolitan)
[*]New glitchy menus (https://trello.com/c/ZO3uUjgI/101-flickering-logo-and-menu-backgrounds)
[*]Feedback when taking damage (https://trello.com/c/o4sxart1/119-feedback-on-damage)
[/list]

Psst! Don't forget the game will be 31% off until tomorrow! ːsteamhappyː

Until next update!!

notes.title: New build B07 - "Guiding Light" is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! New build is up, and this week it's right on time!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fIx6zB7.jpg?1[/img]

It's the seventh update we do for Early Access, and we have called it "Guiding Light" because it's full of challenges that will guide you through the basics of the game: controls, aiming, the sword, the weapons, and hiding.

For instance, this one is about using the sword to attack and to deflect bullets:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ukYrFPS.png[/img]

We are very happy of how the challenges turned out, and we can't wait for your feedback! Since it's a tutorial, we made them quite easy. Don't worry if you blaze through them super-fast: the next ones are going to break your (robotic) bones!

In the next build, we're going to add the Endless mode, with Leaderboards! And more challenges! And save games! And Achievements! ... and whatnot!
(as always, keep an eye [url=https://www.wunderlist.com/list/166273271]on the Roadmap[/url] to know where we're going)

See you in a week!

[h1]The full list of changes:[/h1]

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Way more challenges (https://trello.com/c/SEHTgdOL/106-challenge-stages), and in detail:
[*]In the Dark (https://trello.com/c/C2wcyHj1/109-in-the-dark-aiming-tutorial)
[*]Refined Swordman (https://trello.com/c/KmfSpxhF/113-refined-swordsman-sword-tutorial)
[*]Delivery Package (https://trello.com/c/RxVsviqD/115-delivery-package-compact-tutorial)
[*]The Sheriff (https://trello.com/c/VwLyVymh/114-the-sheriff-shooting-tutorial)
[*]Shooting Range (https://trello.com/c/eLbTBsfP/116-shooting-range-shooting-tutorial)
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Transport System exits now show button prompts (https://trello.com/c/JldlxK9I/103-add-button-prompts-on-transport-system-exits)
[/list]

notes.title: New build B06 - "Lone Wolf" is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! New build is up: B06, codenamed "Lone Wolf"!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MkRRhrSl.jpg[/img]

The biggest single addition to the game this week is the [url=https://trello.com/c/kJngfDty/53-single-player-challenges]Challenge mode[/url]. It is a mode that's composed of a string of challenging scenarios, mostly single-player, that have a difficulty that ramps up from "trivial" to "impossible". The first ones are basically a big tutorial: they teach you the controls and the basics of the game.

In the current update, you'll find only a few challenges though, but don't worry: the biggest part of making that game mode was setting up the whole structure (which is what we just did), while more and more challenges will be coming fast in the following days and weeks.

Another cool thing we added are full-screen effects (see image above). They're currently active for every Quality level, but we'll give you a way to disable them in case they slow your computer down too much.

For the complete list of changes and new features, here it is:

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Single-player Challenges (https://trello.com/c/kJngfDty/53-single-player-challenges)
[*]Added fullscreen effects: SMAA anti-aliasing, bloom effect (https://trello.com/c/6UC29Vn8/104-full-screen-post-processing-effects)
[*]Challenges music track (https://trello.com/c/JgU8vpSU/57-challenges-track)
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Greatly improved rendering (very technical :D)
[*]Small changes to how sword/gun control is handled (https://trello.com/c/Ov7uzX3l/97-swipe-sword-while-shooting)
[*]The usual 1000 bugs fixed (see here: https://trello.com/b/fo6bDn4z/fatal-error-bug-tracking)
[/list]

As usual, keep following [url=https://trello.com/b/YM4O95Z9/fatal-error-development]the Trello board[/url] to see the latest features "as they're made", and post your opinions here in the forums!

notes.title: New build B03 - "The Core" is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
The heat of summer is on us, you’ve probably gone to gamescom (or maybe not) and as we move towards the peak of August, FATAL ERROR update "[i]B03: The Core[/i]" is live. And this one is called “[i]The Core[/i]” for a reason.

You know FATAL ERROR’s core gameplay is based on deception and “hiding” on the same screen. Until now, we only had one mechanic: the [b]Transport System[/b] (the purple holes that teleport you on the conveyor belts in the form of a compacted robot). This update introduces not only one, but two new ones: the [b]Doppelganger[/b] ([url=https://trello.com/c/IjM4aE20/40-doppelganger]on Trello[/url]) and the [b]Invisibility[/b] ([url=https://trello.com/c/OOCXz2IN/17-invisibility]on Trello[/url])!

The [b]Doppelganger[/b] is activated by a green plate you step on, and as soon as you do, a clone of your character is created. The clone is identical to your robot, and it mirrors its movements along an axis (depending on the stage, sometimes it's vertical, sometimes horizontal). The clone is vulnerable and can't kill nor take the Database, but you can use it to confuse your enemies and make them feel under attack when in reality... you're somewhere else.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Rlhh2gu.gif[/img]

The name of this mechanic comes from the German word [i]Doppelgänger[/i], which represents "a clone that looks and moves in the same way".

As for the [b]Invisibility[/b], it's what it sounds: step on a blue plate, and your robot will became [i]nearly[/i] invisible as long as he doesn't shoot or dies. When you shoot, you become visible again. The robot is never 100% invisible, and players with a keen eye might be able to spot invisible opponents.

([i]psst: we have a million changes in mind related to these mechanics already, graphic adjustments, AI refinements, and whatnot, but they're going to come in the next update![/i])

Along with these new powers, we have created [b]3 new stages[/b] (2 Solo stages and one 2v2) taking advantage of the new mechanics: [i]Dungeon[/i], [i]Bloodbath[/i] and [i]Construction Yard[/i], upping the stage number to 9 now!

We have started the process of [b]translating the game[/b]. We only have English and Italian right now, but we're going to implement French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Swedish, and (probably) Norwegian, Russian, Polish, and Finnish as soon as possible. We are going to crowdsource the translations, so if you want to help us in the translation or know someone who does, drop us an email at info [at] fatalexcerror [dot] com. We will give you (or your friend :D) one or more copies of the game as a thank you, and obviously [b]put your name in the credits of the game[/b].

Apart from this, there's always a plethora of minor changes and fixes, which you can find in the Build description [url=https://www.wunderlist.com/list/166273271]on Wunderlist[/url], but here's a recap:

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Invisibility stealth mechanic ([url=https://trello.com/c/OOCXz2IN/17-invisibility]more..[/url])
[*]Doppelganger stealth mechanic ([url=https://trello.com/c/IjM4aE20/40-doppelganger]more..[/url])
[*]Game translated into different languages ([url=https://trello.com/c/j3kAzidU/78-translate-the-game]more..[/url])
[*]New stages specifically built for the new mechanics
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]More feedback on every player action ([url=https://trello.com/c/Xvvkg0MM/43-more-feedback-when-scoring-points]more..[/url])
[*]Sword kills are worth more ([url=https://trello.com/c/CjoiSieH/86-different-points-for-sword-or-firearms]more..[/url])
[*]Streamlined menus and method of control ([url=https://trello.com/c/ieM2hEdr/88-use-the-control-stick-to-move-the-selection-in-the-menus]more..[/url])
[/list]

[b]Bugfix:[/b]
[list]
[*]Inaccurate mouse aiming ([url=https://trello.com/c/WJum8KEd/40-inaccurate-mouse-aiming]more..[/url])
[*]Lead Drone still moves during pause ([url=https://trello.com/c/jsRUq9PD/20-lead-drone-still-moves-during-pause]more..[/url])
[*]Players already have guns in the tutorial on the second time ([url=https://trello.com/c/NMXQi4yl/33-players-already-have-guns-in-the-tutorial-on-the-second-time]more..[/url])
[*]Transport entrance and invisible portal block shots ([url=https://trello.com/c/0INbXoXT/35-transport-entrance-and-invisible-portal-block-shots]more..[/url])
[*]Highlighter a bit off during pre-match players setup ([url=https://trello.com/c/bwI3ug1c/17-highlighter-a-bit-off-during-pre-match-players-setup]more..[/url])
[*][Claimed fixed]Scores stuck on animation ([url=https://trello.com/c/KQaql6Eq/5-scores-stuck-on-animation]more..[/url])
[*][Claimed fixed]Sometimes the Orb is spawned twice per match ([url=https://trello.com/c/kQajeSOw/27-sometimes-the-orb-is-spawned-twice-per-match]more..[/url])
[/list]

Please, play the game with us and tell us whether you like or not the new mechanics and the new stages, and what would you change. As always, your feedback is gold!

Enjoy FATAL ERROR responsibly!

- Ennio
Team ERROR

notes.title: New build B01 - "Quick Fox" is live!
notes.content:
We have just put online a new build, a quick update after yesterday's release nicknamed [i]"Quick Fox"[/i].

The biggest introduction is the possibility for player 1 to play with a keyboard and a mouse. We also shuffled the options around a little bit, and they all save for the next session.

We listened to your feedback (we promised, remember?) and we made the AI a bit dumber, but we also offered the ability to choose from 3 difficulty levels.

This is the full list of changes:

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Keyboard always active in the menus
Player1 can optionally play with a keyboard/mouse
[*]Control schemes are explained in the Controls menu
[*]Many settings are stored (audio levels, controls, graphics) between sessions
[*]AI has 3 different difficulty levels, which can be chosen
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*]Implemented performances whenever bots were present in-game
[*]Flying Drone projects a purple light, so it doesn't feel like it's associated to the green player
[*]Many small fixes here and there (see https://trello.com/b/fo6bDn4z/fatal-error-bug-tracking)
[/list]

Hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Early Access is A-GO!! (+ Videos)
notes.content:
Good news, everyone: FATAL ERROR is now live on Steam!
Please get it while it's hot, and help us shape it with your feedback!

For those of you who missed it, we posted a small trailer yesterday:

https://youtu.be/UvIlYXc8Aac

In the video you can hear part of one of the fantastic tracks ("Lé Saboteur") by our composer [url=https://soundcloud.com/joakimkarlberg]Joakim[/url]. The soundtrack is really great, personally I'm in love with the menu theme!

Here's also a video of gameplay, from the three stages we have for now:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7RmR8nnXDrw

This time the background track is called "Brawl at the Ironworks". See how in the last 30 seconds it goes up in rhythm? Those are the seconds where everything can happen!

Hopefully the videos will give you a clear idea of what the game is about, and how fast-paced it is.

So please, get the game, play it with your friends, and leave us suggestions and comments in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/384100/discussions/]Discussions[/url]! Hope you will enjoy FATAL ERROR!

- Team ERROR
